messages:
jo: quick sync: proposal for prewarm-credit escrow for dedicated pools. idea: tenants buy soft credits that guarantee rapid warmups without permanently reserving GPUs. intended to reduce waste while giving SLAs.

emma: sounds promising. how do credits map to actual prewarm ops? atomic ticket per model-version?

jo: yes: tenant spends N credits -> operator places a prewarm ticket (idempotent). credits are deducted only after prewarm completes or after timeout refund window. gives incentive not to spam.

toby: refund window? need clear failure semantics. if prewarm fails we should auto-refund minus a small fee to deter retries. maybe refund after 2m if not marked ready.

emma: and to prevent thundering herd, a global promotion-rate limiter should exist. config: {"global_promote_rps": 5, "refund_cut": 0.1, "prewarm_timeout_s": 120} (concept).

jo: also want soft-fail path: if no credits or global limit reached, allow cold fallback but tag telemetry with "prewarm:skipped" so product can show degraded SLA.

infra-bot: perf note: implement escrow as a lightweight service with event-sourced ledger. store minimal item: tenant, model, credits_reserved, status. replay safe.

toby: ops question: how do we account for partial-prewarms (multi-GPU sharded models)? credit cost should approximate GPU-seconds. start with a simple per-instance unit and iterate.

emma: metrics to add: escrow.reserved_count, escrow.refund_rate, escrow.promotion_latency, prewarm.success_rate. alert if refund_rate > 2% for 15m.

jo: rollout: 1) small pilot with internal tenants 2) expose API /reserve, /commit, /refund 3) hook into admission facade to prefer reserved warm keys.

toby: one last UX ask: Console should show credit balance + history and a toggle to auto-refund failed prewarms for infra teams.

jo: ok I'll draft a short RFC with sequence diagrams and start an experiment ticket. :white_check_mark:
